content: <thought>To propose a one‑step retrosynthesis, I will look for a Diels‑Alder retrosynthetic template that can disconnect the target into a diene and a dienophile. The target contains a bicyclic system with an ester and a ketone, which is typical of a cycloaddition between cyclopentadiene and a carbonyl‑containing dienophile such as methyl glyoxylate. I will search the template catalog for a Diels‑Alder type transformation (formation of a 6‑membered ring).
